summary: A port of Pink Trombone, a vocal tract synthesizer with a glottis, tongue, lips and nose, played monophonically from the keys and knobs. Tried only in the emulator, never on a real FM-1.
features: Knobs for tongue position and height, lips and tenseness
Nine vowel presets; vibrato and nasal controls
Held buttons add fricatives S, SH, F and stops T/D, K/G, P/B
Drone toggle; chorus, ping-pong delay and reverb
MIDI notes and CCs for the tract, vibrato and effects
The screen draws the throat as it moves; built on fm1-dock

headings: pink trombone for the m-vave fm-1
